checks.name: 1. The asset is a mobile build of the V56 pack: one skinned mesh of at most 35k triangles, WebP textures, under 3 MB, and the run is reproducible from the committed source
2. The skeleton follows the hero convention: 24 joints with the hero names, identity rest rotations, metres (head joint 1.40-1.48 m, crown 1.65-1.75 m), inverse binds that are pure translations
3. Every game clip is there, the walks loop, and one walk loop is the game stride (the pack walk measured 1.47 m per loop)
4. A new household starts Player 1 as V56; an older save without a model keeps the Classic model; Player 2 is never V56
5. Player 1 with V56 is built from the asset with the game animation set, the hero bone map, the carry anchor between the hands, and the contact shadow; the Classic hero is untouched
6. The kit goes on V56 and its torso and neck pieces hang at the hero joint heights
7. The creator offers Classic and V56 in the Body tab for Player 1 only, and the world redraws Player 1 when the choice changes
